x: Analyzes biases from kinematic cuts on anisotropic flow coefficients v0(pT) in heavy-ion collisions.

t: Anisotropic hadronic matter in external magnetic fields
a: Dushmanta Sahu, Jayanta Dey
x: Investigates anisotropic hadronic matter, equation of state, and conserved-charge fluctuations in magnetic fields using a hadron resonance gas framework.

t: The Singular Structure of Rapidity Distributions for Color-Singlet Production at N3LO
a: Federica Devoto, Bernhard Mistlberger, Gherardo Vita
x: Computes universal singular structure and beam-function matching kernels for N3LO rapidity distributions in color-singlet production.

t: Exploring QCD Matter through Energy Correlators of Soft Hadrons
a: Yiyang Peng, João Barata, Andrey V. Sadofyev et al.
x: Applies energy-energy correlators of soft hadrons to heavy-ion collisions and small systems, relevant to hadronization and QCD matter.

t: Universal Long-distance Tail of Particle-number Density near a Wall in Superfluids
a: Keisuke Fujii
x: Calculates the particle-number density tail near a wall in superfluids using effective field theory, offering useful methodological parallels for nuclear surface properties.

t: Improved aluminum film transport properties and enhanced TES response in athermal phonon detectors: implications for quasiparticle dynamics
a: Mahdi Mirzakhani, Keith Hunter, Rupak Mahapatra et al.
x: Reports improved aluminum film transport properties and enhanced TES response for athermal phonon detectors used in Dark Matter and CEvNS experiments.

t: Isovector Monopole Resonance
a: Xavier Roca Maza, Gianluca Colò
x: Theoretical study of the isovector giant monopole resonance and symmetry energy sensitivities using Skyrme functionals, directly relevant to nuclear responses.

t: $N\Lambda$ interaction from a quark model: $p\Lambda$ femtoscopy and the hypertriton
a: Ye Yan, Qian Wu, Qi Huang et al.
x: Investigates low-energy nucleon-Lambda interactions, p-Lambda femtoscopy, and hypertriton binding using quark models, highly relevant to nuclear interactions and hyperon production.

t: Impact of Irrep Truncations on Quantum Simulations of QCD
a: Patrick Draper, Drishti Gupta
x: Analyzes the impact of irrep truncations and electric bases on quantum simulations of SU(3) lattice gauge theory, aligning with advanced theoretical approaches to QCD gauge dynamics.

t: Impact of neutron captures on the r-process: I. Propagation of statistical model uncertainties
a: Yu An, Jan Kuske, Almudena Arcones
x: Hauser-Feshbach statistical uncertainties in neutron-capture rates, dominated by nuclear level densities rather than gamma-ray strength functions, propagate significantly into r-process abundances, particularly in cold nucleosynthesis regimes.

t: Andreev Beta Conversion and Bulk Viscosity in Superfluid Neutron-Star Matter
a: Tingyu Zhang, Honoka Hoshino, Hiroyuki Tajima et al.
x: In superfluid neutron-star matter, coherent Andreev beta conversion mediated by the neutron condensate yields an unsuppressed $T^8$ weak conductance that dominates bulk viscosity over exponentially suppressed quasiparticle Urca at low temperatures.

t: Leading-twist proton parton distribution amplitude from scalar and axial-vector diquark correlations
a: B. Almeida-Zamora, L. Albino, C. Mezrag et al.
x: The leading-twist proton parton distribution amplitude is calculated from Poincaré-covariant quark-diquark Faddeev amplitudes, revealing how axial-vector diquarks soften the strong longitudinal momentum asymmetry produced by scalar diquarks.

t: Gauge-Covariant Wavelets for Quark-Propagator Sparsening and Distillation in Lattice QCD
a: Debsubhra Chakraborty, Nilmani Mathur, Mrinmoy Basak
x: A gauge-covariant wavelet framework combines fast wavelet transform sparsening and resolvent-filtered Laplacian distillation to dramatically accelerate lattice-QCD correlation function computations and contractions without full Laplacian eigensolves.

t: A Levinson's theorem for particle form factors
a: Francesco Rosini, Simone Pacetti
x: The authors prove a form-factor version of Levinson's theorem, demonstrating that the asymptotic timelike phase is uniquely fixed by the number of zeros and the pQCD power-law falloff.

t: Neutrino Anomalies and Tensions: Experimental Status and Theoretical Interpretations
a: Doris Barčot, Raoul Serao, Antonio Capolupo
x: This review synthesizes experimental neutrino anomalies and parameter tensions, systematically contrasting interpretations including $3+1$ steriles, non-standard interactions, decoherence, and decay across complementary channels.

t: A REST-based Monte Carlo Simulation and Data Analysis Framework for the N$\nu$DEx Experiment
a: Siyuan Huang, Tao Li, Hao Qiu et al.
x: A simulation and reconstruction framework based on the REST toolkit is developed for the N$\nu$DEx-100 high-pressure gaseous $^{82}\text{SeF}_6$ TPC searching for $0\nu\beta\beta$.

t: Neural Network Representation of Generalized Parton Distributions (NNGPD)
a: Simonetta Liuti, Jitao Xu, Ho Jang et al.
x: The authors introduce NNGPD, a physics-informed neural network framework that reconstructs Generalized Parton Distributions from integral observables like Compton form factors and Mellin moments without pointwise $x$-space training.

t: Two-nucleon scattering amplitudes at light quark masses from lattice QCD
a: Jorge Baeza-Ballesteros (BaSc), André Baião-Raposo (BaSc), Davide Laudicina (BaSc) et al.
x: The BaSc Collaboration extracts nucleon-nucleon scattering amplitudes at near-physical pion masses down to $M_\pi \approx 200\text{ MeV}$ from lattice QCD, explicitly accounting for the one-pion exchange left-hand cut.

t: Reactor Antineutrino Detection with JUNO-TAO: Commissioning Performance and First Results
a: JUNO Collaboration
x: JUNO-TAO reports its commissioning and first physics data, achieving an energy resolution of $2.8\%$ at $1\text{ MeV}$ and measuring an IBD candidate rate of $2900\pm 10\text{ events/day}$.

t: Minkowski Functionals of CII Line Intensity Maps: Probing Astrophysics and Primordial Features
a: Sandeep Kumar Acharya, Pravabati Chingangbam
x: Minkowski functionals of CII intensity maps at high redshift touch on cosmological probes and primordial features.

t: Localized states of the non-Hermitian Schr{\"o}dinger equation with a complex $1/r^{2}$ potential: from Efimov states to bipolarons
a: Kyoka Tsunoda, Kazuki Yamamoto, Shimpei Endo
x: Examines complex potentials bridging Efimov states and polarons, offering distant methodological parallels to few-body nuclear physics.

t: Ergodic topology sampling toward the continuum with Stochastic Normalizing Flows
a: Claudio Bonanno, Andrea Bulgarelli, Elia Cellini et al.
x: Stochastic normalizing flows for topological freezing in SU(3) Yang-Mills are methodologically interesting for lattice QCD, though not directly applied here to nucleon form factors.

t: Compact Dark Matter with Globular Cluster Pulsars
a: Soobeom Chung, Jeff A. Dror
x: Uses pulsar timing arrays and globular clusters to search for compact dark matter objects via the Shapiro effect, offering minor context for astrophysical neutrino sources.

t: Efficient numerical evolution of self-gravitating systems with dark-matter-baryon scattering
a: Marc Kamionkowski, Vera Gluscevic, Kris Sigurdson
x: Numerical simulations of dark matter-baryon scattering and gas cooling touch on astrophysical environments, though not directly on neutrino cross sections.

t: Spurious Singularities in Dipole Subtraction Cross Sections and their Damping with Convergence Factors
a: Michael H. Seymour (University of Manchester, University of Southampton, CERN) et al.
x: Proposes convergence factors to damp spurious singularities in dipole subtraction cross sections for NLO calculations.

t: Modified hydrogen recombination rate due to non-Hubble redshift effects
a: I. V Krasnov, N. S. Nedelko
x: Investigates non-Hubble redshift effects on Lyman-alpha photon escape during cosmic hydrogen recombination.

t: First Observation of the Radiative Decay $D^0 \to \gamma\omega$
a: BESIII Collaboration, M. Ablikim, M. N. Achasov et al.
x: First observation of the radiative decay D0 to gamma omega by BESIII using deep learning, relevant to non-perturbative QCD calculations.

t: From Non-Thermal to Thermal: Cosmological Imprints of Self-Interacting Secluded Dark Matter
a: Koushik Dutta, Deep Ghosh, Ahamadullah Khan
x: Investigates internal thermalization and phase-space evolution of secluded self-interacting scalar dark matter.

t: Decay modeling in 4top production
a: Manal Alsairafi
x: NLO QCD predictions and parton-shower matching for four-top production with full spin correlations.

t: Hidden-charm and hidden-beauty hybrid mesons
a: Raghavendra Kaushal, Bhaghyesh
x: Computes hybrid charmonium and bottomonium mass spectra using non-relativistic potential models.

t: Revisiting $B_c^{(*)}$ production in $Z$-boson decays at NLO in QCD
a: Qi-Wei Ke, Lei Guo, Jun Zeng et al.
x: Calculates NLO QCD corrections to Bc and Bc* production in Z boson decays using NRQCD.

t: Determining the Threshold Excess in Top-Quark Pair Production through a Global PDF Analysis
a: Richard D. Ball, Jaco ter Hoeve
x: Global PDF analysis of threshold excesses in top-quark pair production.

t: PTagent: An LLM-assisted tool for finite-temperature model construction in cosmological phase transitions
a: Lei Wu, Yang Xiao, Jin Min Yang et al.
x: Introduces an LLM agent framework for constructing finite-temperature cosmological phase transition models, aligning with interest in ML/AI workflows.

t: Two-loop HTL-resummed thermodynamics for pure $\mathcal N=2$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory
a: Qianqian Du, Bingxiang Luo, Ubaid Tantary
x: Computes two-loop HTL thermodynamics for supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory.

t: Bounds on hadronic contributions to the anomalous magnetic moment of the $\tau$ lepton from QCD Sum Rules
a: Siyuan Li, J. Ho, R. T. Kleiv et al.
x: Applies QCD sum rules to constrain hadronic vacuum polarization for lepton magnetic moments.

t: All three-loop four-point massless integrals with one off-shell leg
a: Thomas Gehrmann, Petr Jakubčík, Jungwon Lim et al.
x: Computes master integrals for NN-N-NLO QCD corrections at colliders, useful for high-precision precision backgrounds.

t: Jianmu-Q: Bridging Quantum Field Theory and Quantum Hardware with AI Agents
a: Xiaolin Wang, Xingyu Guo, Jinyang Li et al.
x: Introduces a multi-agent framework to translate quantum field theories into quantum simulation workflows (Schwinger and NJL models), offering an interesting AI workflow tool.

t: Probing the Axion--Photon--Dark Photon Interaction with LHC Mono-Photons and Fermi-LAT Gamma-Ray Lines
a: Chuan-Ren Chen, Takaaki Nomura, Van Que Tran
x: Derives collider and gamma-ray line constraints on axion-photon-dark photon couplings using CMS mono-photons and Fermi-LAT.

t: Lossy Lorentz boosts at ultra-relativistic energies: Numerical study and source survey of high-energy physics software
k: Lossy Lorentz Boosts in HEP Software
a: Christian Bierlich
x: Examines numerical precision loss in Lorentz boost implementations across high-energy physics and air-shower software packages.

t: One generation of the Standard Model as a quantum error-correcting code
a: Shiroman Prakash, K. L. Ramya
x: Examines fermion generations of the Standard Model and anomaly cancellation as triorthogonal quantum error-correcting codes.

t: Multi-Higgs production from a theory of varying Higgs quartic and top Yukawa couplings
a: Ulf Danielsson, Rikard Enberg, Gunnar Ingelman et al.
x: Collider phenomenology of varying Higgs quartic and top Yukawa couplings leading to multi-Higgs and top final states.

t: Non-Invertible Froggatt-Nielsen Symmetry
a: Hajime Otsuka, Ryo Yokokura
x: Constructs non-invertible completions of flavor symmetries and applies them to Dirac neutrino mass textures via instanton effects.

t: Algebraic coefficients of fractional parentage for three particles in the oscillator Jacobi basis
a: A. Stepšys, S. Mickevičius, D. Germanas
x: Presents an algebraic, closed-form construction of coefficients of fractional parentage for three particles in harmonic oscillator bases.

t: Nonleptonic decays of the double-charmed baryon $\Xi_{cc}^{+}$ with dynamically determined baryon wave functions
a: Yu-Shuai Li, Hong-Tao An
x: Evaluates nonleptonic decays of Xi_cc+ baryons using potential models and dynamically determined three-body wave functions.

t: CT25: the new generation of CTEQ-TEA PDFs
a: Alim Ablat, Daniel Adamiak, Aurore Courtoy et al.
x: Reviews new CTEQ-TEA global PDF fits with novel treatments of nuclear-target and high-$x$ uncertainties.

t: Effective shear viscosity from the friction term in relativistic multi-fluid hydrodynamics
a: Christian Spieles, Marcus Bleicher
x: Computes effective shear viscosity dynamically from nuclear friction in relativistic multi-fluid heavy-ion collisions.

t: Four-dimensional QCD equation of state with a critical surface from contours of constant entropy density
a: Tristan Gyure, Hitansh Shah, Lorenzo Formaggio et al.
x: Constructs a 4D QCD equation of state with a critical surface from lattice QCD, relevant to heavy-ion collisions and high-density matter.

t: Collective Organization of String Fragmentation
a: Romuald A. Janik, Maciej A. Nowak, Marek M. Rams et al.
x: Applies tensor networks to Schwinger model string fragmentation, providing microscopic insights into hadronization and Lund area laws.

t: Dark Matter Particle Explorer: Ten-Year On-Orbit Performance and Scientific Outcomes
a: Jian-Hua Guo, Chuan Yue, Yun-Long Zhang et al.
x: Ten-year status and cosmic-ray electron/gamma results from the DAMPE space mission provide useful background on high-energy astroparticle environments.

t: From Axion Detection to Dark Matter Astronomy
a: Jae Hyeok Chang, Stefano Profumo
x: Examines how global haloscope networks can map dark matter substructure and velocity flows from axion direct detection signals.

t: Radiative transitions of hybrid mesons
a: Shahriyar Jafarzade, Eric S. Swanson
x: Calculates radiative transitions of hybrid charmonium in Coulomb-gauge QCD, relevant to exotic hadron searches at Jefferson Lab.

t: Two-variable longitudinal distribution of the $\Lambda_b$ in a three-quark light-front model
a: Shuai Xu, Xiao-Nan Li
x: Determines the two-variable longitudinal momentum distribution of the Lambda_b baryon using a covariant three-quark light-front wave function.

t: Testing the inelastic dark matter interpretation of the LZ event with heavy-element experiments
k: Inelastic Dark Matter and Solar Neutrinos
a: Peter W. Graham, Juan P. Luengas, Harikrishnan Ramani et al.
x: Tests dark matter interpretations of the LZ anomaly against solar neutrino bounds and high-velocity tail velocity distributions.

t: Signatures of Leptophilic Baryogenesis at Muon Colliders
a: Hooman Davoudiasl, Ian M. Lewis, Miguel A. Soto Alcaraz
x: Studies leptophilic Higgs troika baryogenesis and its distinct signatures at future multi-TeV muon colliders.

t: Auditing anapole dark matter: the limits of model independence in dark matter effective field theory
a: Duncan K. Adams, Jared Barron, Megan H. McDuffie
x: Examines limitations of EFT for anapole dark matter and importance of UV completions across colliders and direct detection.

t: Technically Natural Baryogenesis with the QCD Axion
a: Pouya Asadi, David Cyncynates, Stefania Gori
x: Discusses multi-axion dynamics for baryogenesis and dark matter, offering indirect connections to BSM cosmology.

t: Stimulated capture of axion dark matter around primordial black holes
a: Nuno P. Branco, João G. Rosa
x: Studies stimulated capture of axion dark matter around primordial black holes and transient line signals in magnetospheres, relevant for BSM portal searches.

t: Disentangling geometry & growth in cosmic neutrino mass constraints: a more physical split and diagnostic
a: Fei Ge, Frank J. Qu, Hanyue Wang et al.
x: Disentangles geometry and growth in cosmological constraints on neutrino mass sums, offering relevant context for global oscillation and mass analyses.

t: The Sill distribution for all partial waves
a: Krzysztof Kyzio\l, Francesco Giacosa
x: Extends the Sill resonance line-shape distribution to arbitrary partial waves with proper threshold behavior, successfully benchmarking against the Delta(1232) pole.

t: Extracting the Central Sound Speed of Neutron Stars through Intrinsic Stellar Structure Scaling with Reduced Equation-of-State Model Dependence
a: Jian-Hao Shi, Bao-Jun Cai, Yu-Gang Ma
x: Intrinsic perturbative TOV scaling yields an EOS-independent estimator for the central sound speed of canonical neutron stars, constraining $s_{\rm c}^2 \approx 0.52$ and radius $\approx 11.7\text{ km}$ across diverse nonlinear Walecka models.

t: Identification of ultra-high-energy neutrinos in vertical air showers with surface detectors
a: Jaime Alvarez-Muñiz, Ruben Conceição, Pedro J. Costa et al.
x: Surface detector arrays can identify vertical ($\theta \leq 60^\circ$) ultra-high-energy electron-neutrino air showers around $10^{18}\text{ eV}$ by separating electromagnetic and muonic signals using combined water-Cherenkov and scintillator detectors.

t: Low-Scale See-Saw Mechanism and the Majorana Nature of Heavy Neutrinos
a: Takuya Okawa, S. T. Petcov
x: Heavy neutral leptons in low-scale type-I seesaw models can reveal their Majorana or Dirac nature at future $e^+e^-$ and $\mu^+\mu^-$ colliders via forward-backward angular distribution asymmetries.

t: Nuclear PDFs
a: K. Greve, T. Ježo, M. Klasen et al.
x: Global NLO analyses of nuclear PDFs (nCTEQ26 preliminary, EPPS21, nNNPDF3.0) and NNLO TUJU21 are systematically compared, highlighting data sensitivities, strange-sea constraints from neutrino DIS, and $A$-dependent uncertainty patterns.

t: Leptogenesis with a GeV-Scale Quasi-Dirac Neutrino
a: Stephen F. King, Soumen Kumar Manna, Rishav Roshan et al.
x: Thermal Higgs decays ($H\to LN$) in the early Universe generate the baryon asymmetry via GeV-scale quasi-Dirac neutrinos with symmetry-protected mass splitting, testable at SHiP, MATHUSLA, and FCC-ee.

t: The hadronic-vacuum-polarization contribution to the muon anomalous magnetic moment in isospin-symmetric lattice QCD with twisted-mass fermions
a: C. Alexandrou (Extended Twisted Mass Collaboration), S. Bacchio (Extended Twisted Mass Collaboration), A. De Santis (Extended Twisted Mass Collaboration) et al.
x: ETMC reports a high-precision lattice QCD determination of the leading-order hadronic vacuum polarization in isospin-symmetric QCD, yielding $a_\mu^{\rm HVP} = (714.9 \pm 8.1)\times 10^{-10}$, consistent with the Fermilab $(g-2)_\mu$ measurement.

t: $^6$He structure from semiclassical 3D models based on $\textit{ab initio}$ spatial correlations
a: Mengyao Huang, Tobias Frederico, Peng Yin et al.
x: Semiclassical 3D geometric models based on ab initio no-core shell model two-body spatial correlations reveal that the $\alpha$ core of $^6\text{He}$ is significantly flattened by valence halo neutrons.

t: DUNE Beam-Energy Dependence of Sensitivity to the Violation of the Equivalence Principle
a: Monjowara Khatun, Debajyoti Dutta
x: A DUNE simulation demonstrates that the Low-Energy beam tune provides superior sensitivity to violations of the equivalence principle over the Medium-Energy tune by concentrating statistics at the first oscillation maximum.

t: Gallium Anomaly and Solar Neutrinos
a: Steven R. Elliott, R. G. Hamish Robertson
x: Calibrating the solar neutrino flux with elastic scattering and SNO neutral-current measurements yields a predicted $^{71}\text{Ga}$ rate matching Gallex/SAGE, showing the Gallium Anomaly does not stem from cross sections or detection efficiencies.

t: Machine-learning-based neutrino-event generation constrained by experimental measurements
a: Jose Luis Bonilla, Krzysztof M. Graczyk, Rwik Dharmapal Banerjee et al.
x: A generative surrogate for $\nu_\mu$-nucleus scattering combines a cross-section DNN and cGAN, enabling calibration directly to unfolded, smeared MicroBooNE differential cross sections via differentiable histogramming without event-level experimental data.

t: Can bosenovae deplete the galactic dark matter?
a: Samuel Gómez Gómez, Joshua Eby
x: Calculates whether bosenovae of gravitational atoms and boson stars can significantly deplete galactic dark matter halos.

t: Thermalization of the Primordial Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background
a: Hongguang Zhang, Zhengyang Qiu, Sirui Wang et al.
x: Examines self-interaction and thermalization of high-occupation primordial gravitons from inflation into a Bose-Einstein distribution.

t: Audible curvaton: modulated phase transition as the origin of large-scale curvature perturbations and gravitational wave anisotropies
a: Wen-Yuan Ai, Gabriele Franciolini, Xin Wang et al.
x: Proposes a post-inflationary phase transition generating curvature perturbations and stochastic gravitational waves.

t: Top-Quark Mass Scheme Uncertainties in Higgs Boson Pair Production via Gluon Fusion
a: Clara Del Pio, Sebastian Jaśkiewicz, Rebecca von Kuk et al.
x: Calculates top-quark mass scheme uncertainties in Higgs pair production, which is outside the reader's neutrino physics focus.

t: Fast Monte Carlo calculation of multiple scattering in resonant neutron capture
a: R. M. Djilkibaev
x: Develops a fast Monte Carlo code to calculate multiple neutron scattering and capture resonances in samples.

t: MoEDAL-MAPP: the first dedicated search experiment at the LHC
a: John R. Ellis, Nick E. Mavromatos, Vasiliki A. Mitsou et al.
x: Special issue covering the MoEDAL-MAPP experiment at the LHC searching for anomalously ionizing and highly charged particles.

t: Quantum-enhanced Search for Galactic Dark Photons Using Cat-State Cavities
a: Aoying Wang, Yanjie Zeng, Yanyan Cai et al.
x: Reinterprets quantum-enhanced superconducting circuit cavity data to set bounds on Galactic dark-photon backgrounds.

t: Radion/Dilaton portal freeze-in dark matter in extra-dimensional theories
a: Amrita Mukherjee, George Sanamyan, Dipan Sengupta
x: Analyzes freeze-in dark matter via a radion/dilaton portal in stabilized warped extra-dimensional models.

t: Quasiparticle Modeling of Strongly Magnetized Strange Quark Systems
a: Yogesh Kumar, Manas Lohani, Poonam Jain et al.
x: Examines spin-polarized strange quark matter and strange stars using a quasiparticle model under strong magnetic fields.

t: Effects of quadratic frequency chirping and carrier-envelope phase on Schwinger pair production in polarized electric fields
a: Abhinav Jangir
x: Investigates electron-positron pair production in polarized electric fields with frequency chirping using the Dirac-Heisenberg-Wigner formalism.

t: Strangeness suppression, the $\phi$ meson and $\Lambda\bar\Lambda$ spin correlations from exact strangeness conservation at the quark level
a: P. Castorina, H. Satz
x: Examines exact strangeness conservation at the quark level to explain suppression and spin correlations in small collision systems.

t: Displaced tracks as a signal of dark matter co-annihilation: a case study using inert doublet model at $e^+e^-$ collider
a: Hrishikesh Deka, Subhaditya Bhattacharya, Amir Subba et al.
x: Explores displaced tracks and disappearing charged states from dark matter co-annihilation within the Inert Doublet Model at lepton colliders.

t: Thermal properties of the $\rho$ meson from a machine-learning-improved holographic QCD model
a: Jia-Jie Jiang, Han Tang, Danning Li et al.
x: Uses a machine-learning-improved holographic QCD model to study thermal spectral functions and quasi-normal modes of the rho meson.

t: Measurement of Born cross sections of $e^+e^-\to pK^{-}\bar\Sigma^{0}$ + c.c. at $\sqrt{s}$ = 3.5-4.9 GeV and partial wave analysis at $\sqrt{s}$ = 3.773 GeV
a: BESIII Collaboration, M. Ablikim, M. N. Achasov et al.

t: Achieving a 0.49 keV threshold in the COSINE-100 dark matter experiment
a: J. Kim (COSINE-100 Collaboration), N. Carlin (COSINE-100 Collaboration), D. F. F. S. Cavalcante (COSINE-100 Collaboration) et al.

t: Collective-flow signatures of bubble nuclei in intermediate-energy projectile fragmentation reactions
a: Ge Ren, Chun-Wang Ma, Xi-Guang Cao et al.

t: R-process nuclei in the rare-earth region above N=126 in Relativistic Hartree-Bogoliubov theory: A preponderance of shape-coexistence in nuclei

a: Zhou-Run Zhu, Zhanyuan Gao, Zhaohui Feng et al.

t: Strange-quark-number-dependent response to partonic dynamics in baryon-rich Au+Au collisions
a: Di Zhao, Xun Zhu, Gao-Chan Yong
x: Identifies strange-quark-number-dependent responses to partonic dynamics in heavy-ion collisions, relevant to nuclear matter transport and strangeness production.

t: Effective Fermion-Photon Vertex in a Rotating Relativistic Medium: Tree-Level Structure
a: Jorge David Castaño-Yepes, Alejandro Ayala, J. E. Martínez-Herrera et al.

t: Two-loop $gg\to AA$ amplitudes near threshold and the double parton scattering singularity
a: Arunima Bhattacharya
x: Analyzes two-loop amplitudes and double parton scattering singularities for pseudoscalar production in gluon fusion, touching on perturbative QCD factorization.

t: Evolution of multihadron fragmentation functions with nonperturbative behavior
a: K. Makino, T. C. Rogers

t: Transport of hard probes in the glasma
a: Dana Avramescu
x: Studies jet and heavy quark transport through the glasma stage of heavy-ion collisions using classical Yang-Mills equations and light-front Hamiltonian methods.

t: Decoherence as a Detector-Resolution Flow

x: Models QED final-state radiation and open quantum system decoherence as a detector-resolution flow, touching on quantum coherence and final states.

t: Binding energies in the $0^{-+}$ and $1^{--}$ fermion--antifermion channels from the ladder Bethe-Salpeter and Schr\"odinger equations
a: Wei He, Hai-Qing Zhou

a: T. de Oliveira, D. Harnett, J. Ho et al.

a: A. V. Afanasjev, B. Bally, M. Bender et al.

t: Measurement of electromagnetic transition form factors in two-photon collisions at BESIII
a: Max Lellmann (on behalf of the BESIII collaboration)

t: Brownian GPDs: A Stochastic Calculus Approach to Generalized Parton Distributions from Integral Constraints
a: Douglas Q. Adams, Simonetta Liuti, Zaki Panjsheeri et al.

t: Spin and 3D structure: theoretical advances
a: Markus Diehl

t: The dead-cone effect in charm, bottom and top quark jets in angular and momentum space
a: Redamy Perez-Ramos, Stefan Kluth, Wolfgang Ochs

t: The Semileptonic B Frontier: LHC, B-factories, Lattice QCD & the Hunt for Precision
a: F. De Fazio, P. De Simone, M. Fedele et al.

t: Constraints on pion parton distributions at small $x$ from leading-neutron electroproduction data

t: Born-Oppenheimer chiral effective field theory and its application to $X_b$
a: Yu Zhang, Feng-Kun Guo, Christoph Hanhart et al.
x: Formulates Born-Oppenheimer chiral EFT in momentum space to describe the $1^{++}$ bottomonium spectrum, predicting that the observed $\chi_{b1}(3P)$ is a molecular $X_b$ and identifying an undiscovered compact partner.

t: Transient PULSE: Code for the Transient Propagation of UltraLight (pseudo)Scalars to Earth
a: Jason Arakawa, Charles Cheung, Muhammad Hani Zaheer et al.
x: Presents Transient PULSE, a Python software package that simulates the propagation, dispersion, and medium-screening of transient ultralight scalar and pseudoscalar bursts from astrophysical transients to terrestrial detectors.

t: Correlation of galactic very-high-energy gamma-ray sources detected by LHAASO with high-energy neutrinos
a: Long-Yu Zhang, Kai Wang
x: Demonstrates that the spatial coincidence between 90 LHAASO very-high-energy gamma-ray sources and 348 IceCube high-energy track alerts is statistically consistent with random background.

t: Constraining three-nucleon forces in nuclear lattice effective field theory
a: Serdar Elhatisari, Ulf-G. Meißner, Zhengxue Ren et al.
x: Constrains short-range chiral three-nucleon forces in nuclear lattice effective field theory at N3LO using nuclear binding energies up to $A=40$ and neutron-alpha scattering data.

t: Pythia-Contrib: a modular contribution framework for the Pythia 8 event generator
a: Benoit Assi, Christian Bierlich, Rikab Gambhir et al.
x: Introduces Pythia-Contrib, a modular runtime plugin framework allowing third-party developers to contribute new models and external dependencies to Pythia 8 without modifying or bloating the core codebase.

t: Measuring $V_{cb}$ at electron-proton colliders
a: David Marzocca
x: Bottom-tagged charged-current deep-inelastic scattering ($e^- c \to \nu_e b$) at future electron-proton colliders like the LHeC and FCC-eh can measure $|V_{cb}|$ with sub-percent precision, independent of semileptonic $B$ decays.

t: Universal enhancement of the pairing gap in a dilute Fermi superfluid
k: Universal pairing gap in dilute Fermi gas
a: Silas R. Beane, Roland C. Farrell, Cameron P. Shotwell
x: The pairing gap in a dilute Fermi superfluid exhibits a trans-series expansion where low-energy virtual quasiparticles generate a large linear-in-gap correction that enhances the gap beyond the Gor'kov-Melik-Barkhudarov prediction.

t: Coherent states of neutrinos in rotating matter
a: Alexander Breev, Maxim Dvornikov
x: Generalized coherent states for massless Dirac neutrinos electroweakly interacting with rotating matter are constructed in light-cone variables, yielding an effective mass and a smooth transition to plane waves.

t: Excited-State Effects in Nucleon Sigma Terms from a Variational Analysis
k: Excited-state effects in nucleon sigma terms
a: Constantia Alexandrou, Giannis Koutsou, Yan Li et al.
x: A variational GEVP analysis with multihadron $N\sigma$ interpolators and Laplace filtering suppresses excited-state contamination in lattice QCD extractions of nucleon scalar sigma-terms at physical pion masses.

t: Direct Detection of Solar Neutrinos to Probe Tensions and Break Degeneracies in Long-Baseline Neutrino Experiments
a: Dorian W. P. Amaral, David Cerdeño, Andrew Cheek et al.
x: Solar neutrino CEvNS and electron scattering in dark matter direct detection experiments can break parameter degeneracies in long-baseline neutrino experiments and constrain non-standard neutrino interaction solutions to the NOvA-T2K tension.
